source: Author NDA-free professional project log; academic/consulting source narratives for remaining cases

debubbler.story: Integrated separation to avoid a standalone debubbler; led iterative geometry/pressure-drop and air-routing evaluation with mechanical design; selected layout prototyped, customer-tested, incorporated.
debubbler.boundary: Professional steady Eulerian-Eulerian vs public transient VOF; 78.2% is only the demo internal-routing metric. Synthetic variants stay labelled.

hydrogen-dilution.story: Baffle/back-pressure comparison and fan-driven dilution sensitivity; compare mixture, extraction and hydraulic resistance.
hydrogen-dilution.boundary: Three-tower 4/10 mol% illustration is a separate study; outlet monitors fluctuate, no safety/convergence claim.

throttle-body.story: Bench capacity blocked larger-valve characterization; establish CFD with a measurable valve, extend operating matrix, deliver mass-flow curves.
throttle-body.boundary: Public geometry/image not industrial map or validation dataset; private driver is not an automatic angle sweep.

pump.story: Integration changes mean hydraulic performance and pressure pulsations; professional signal-processing tool motivates reusable Python workflow.
pump.boundary: Generic performance/spectra/CPU-GPU metrics stay case-specific; no IP status or radiated sound claims.

reactor.story: Academic synthesis problem; dimensionless thermal reasoning connects precursor placement to observed growth.
reactor.boundary: Masters research, not an industrial log demonstration.

aneurysm.story: Separate rheology, turbulence, FSI and particle studies to assess model assumptions.
aneurysm.boundary: Doctoral research; no clinical validation or single combined experiment implied.

ventilation.story: Consulting layout comparison; room-level wind paths and separate solar exposure.
ventilation.boundary: Independent case, no quantified energy savings.
